name: Castle Lanes
summary:
Castle Lanes is a competitive builder-autobattler inspired by the Warcraft III custom map Castle Fight. Place buildings that train soldiers automatically, read your opponent's army, and build the counter that breaks their castle. No workers. No unit micro. Just economy, composition and timing.

Choose Vanguard, Grove or Ember - three factions with 54 units and a hero for each player. Play 1v1 or 2v2 online, or take on the AI offline. Matches run about 15-20 minutes.
